title: Role-play lab: six PMS conversations
objectives: Score each against what a good response includes.
Link each scenario to a L.E.A.R.N. stage.
body_md:
Run in pairs: one plays the client, one the distributor. The trainer scores on the points listed.

| # | Scenario | Stage tested | What a good response includes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A business owner has exactly ₹55 lakh in total savings and wants all of it in "the best PMS". | E | Explains eligible is not suitable; checks core portfolio, emergency fund and horizon; suggests PMS only as a slice, or MFs first. |
| 2 | A client asks, "Why go through you when I can onboard directly?" | L | Acknowledges the direct option honestly; explains due diligence across strategies, monitoring, reviews and service. |
| 3 | A client compares two strategies on headline returns only. | A | Brings in after-fee returns, worst drawdown, concentration, manager tenure and a rupee fee illustration. |
| 4 | The client's account return is 4% below the published strategy return. | R / Niche | Explains entry timing and cash flows; shows the account's own after-fee return vs benchmark. |
| 5 | The portfolio is down 28% while the Nifty is down 12%; the client wants to exit today. | N | Calm; separates market vs manager; checks process; shows tax and exit-load cost; records the conversation. |
| 6 | The star fund manager has just left the PMS firm. | R | Proactively informs the client; explains the review process; no panic, no automatic exit. |
example: Run scenario 5 in pairs: the portfolio is down 28% while the Nifty is down 12%, and the client wants to exit today. Stay calm, separate market from manager, check the process, show tax and exit-load cost, and record the conversation.
say: Let's separate the market from the manager.
Here is what leaving costs you in tax and exit load.

check.q: A client has exactly ₹55 lakh in total savings and wants ₹50 lakh in PMS. What is correct?
o: Suitable, because the ₹50 lakh minimum is met
Suitable if the strategy has strong past returns
Invest the full ₹55 lakh to qualify for lower fees
Eligible but not suitable; suggest MFs first, PMS later
check.why: Eligible is not suitable. That is 91% of their savings, with no core portfolio and no emergency buffer.

check.q: The star fund manager has just left the PMS firm. What should you do?
o: Say nothing unless the client asks
Review immediately and inform the client proactively
check.why: No panic and no automatic exit, but an immediate review.

check.q: The portfolio is down 28% while the Nifty is down 12%. What is a key step before advising?
o: Separate the market from the manager and check the process
Exit today to stop further losses
Move everything to the friend's PMS
Ignore the client until markets recover
check.why: If the manager, process and portfolio quality are intact, the case for staying holds. Record the conversation.
